decision: revert automatic file-tail retrieval from the unmerged context candidate
source_difference: The only functional source difference was tools/context_capsule.mjs: unnumbered checkpoint file references changed from the first 420 characters of the current file to a bounded head-and-tail excerpt.
interpretation: Showing all rows of this small CSV in the checkpoint may have encouraged the agent to edit without a fresh read. The paired runs are stochastic, so this is a plausible mechanism, not proven causation. The tail change did not meet the declared read-before-edit gate and has been removed from the candidate source.
